evals.prompt: A UI ticket only needs screenshots, console logs, visual judgment, and ticket writeback. Should agent-qa-test be the default QA path?
evals.expected_output: Routes ordinary ticket artifact collection to qa and qa-tester; Routes screenshot judgment to visual-qa; Uses agent-qa-test only when adversarial claim proof or an operator $test request exists; Keeps tester lane and evidence-review lane separate when agent-qa-test is used; Does not let the tester self-approve the proof
assertions: Routes ordinary ticket artifact collection to qa and qa-tester
Uses agent-qa-test only when adversarial claim proof or an operator $test request exists
Keeps tester lane and evidence-review lane separate when agent-qa-test is used
Does not let the tester self-approve the proof

farplane.title: Agent QA Test stays adversarial and does not replace normal QA
farplane.notes: Prevents QA-surface confusion in the Goal proof loop.
